	<header class="entry-header">
		<h2 class="entry-title"><b>Hua Hin</b></h2><div class="title-border"></div>        <img width="900" height="600" src="https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/image8.jpeg" class="attachment-post-thumbnail size-post-thumbnail wp-post-image" alt="" decoding="async" srcset="https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/image8.jpeg 900w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/image8-300x200.jpeg 300w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/image8-768x512.jpeg 768w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/image8-600x400.jpeg 600w" sizes="(max-width: 900px) 100vw, 900px" />		<div class="entry-meta">
			<span class="posted-on">Posted on <a href="https://www.kitethailand.com/2018/06/19/kiteboarding-hua-hin/" rel="bookmark"><time class="entry-date published" datetime="2018-06-19T05:11:50+00:00">June 19, 2018</time><time class="updated" datetime="2021-08-16T03:22:10+00:00">August 16, 2021</time></a></span><span class="byline"> by <span class="author vcard"><a class="url fn n" href="https://www.kitethailand.com/author/sam1978/">Eran Forshlager</a></span></span>		</div>
	</header>
	<div class="entry-content">
		<p>[rl_gallery id=&#8221;648&#8243;]</p>
<h1><strong>Enjoy the experience of kitesurfing in&nbsp;</strong><strong>Hua Hin&nbsp;</strong><strong>at the Kite Thailand kiktesurfing school Hua Hin</strong></h1>
<p><img decoding="async" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-1515" src="https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/thumbnail-1.jpg" alt="" width="1871" height="1080" srcset="https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/thumbnail-1.jpg 1871w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/thumbnail-1-300x173.jpg 300w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/thumbnail-1-768x443.jpg 768w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/thumbnail-1-1024x591.jpg 1024w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/thumbnail-1-600x346.jpg 600w" sizes="(max-width: 1871px) 100vw, 1871px" /></p>
<p>Hua Hin is a well-known seaside resort on the Gulf of Thailand. Smaller and generally more quiet than some of Thailand’s other beaches, it’s the perfect family-friendly location to spend holidays in Thailand. If you have young children that cannot kitesurf, there is also waterpark and great places to do other watersports like wakeboard. Hua Hin is also family has a great range of hotels and guesthouses to suit all budgets. Expect a great selection of restaurants and shopping centres. You will usually be able to simply turn up and find a place to stay, although around Christmas and New Year or Songkran Festival (for 1 week around April 13<sup>th</sup>) periods, many places are fully booked so we recommend you reserve in advance.</p>
<p>Hua Hin offers a great environment for kiteboarders of all ages and skill levels. Hua Hin is a 3 hr drive south of Bangkok, making it a great beach option to visit if you’re traveling to Bangkok and don’t want to have to take a flight to enjoy the seaside. The cooling sea breeze, charming fishing port, history and nightlife make for an enjoyable stay. Besides kitesurfing, Hua Hin has plenty to offer. If you’re looking for somewhere to wakeboard in Thailand, this is a great location option. Some of the activities available in Hua Hin include world class golf courses, driving ranges, the Royal Palace, horseriding, waterpark and wakeboarding, a vineyard, waterfalls, the floating market, elephant village, paramotor, mountain biking, and nightlife.</p>
<p><strong>Hua Hin Thailand Kitesurfing</strong><strong> key points:</strong></p>
<p>For an amazing Hua Hin kitesurfing experience, visit our kite school in this location – this was our first school location and remains our headquarters to this day! The winds in Hua Hin are perfect for kitesurfing, and our school is in a charming location with a 6 km sandy beach. The main kiteboarding season is from October through to May, and we get very consistent side shore winds. At the Kite Thailand kitesurfing school Hua Hin, you can:</p>
<ul>
<li>Book kitesurfing and SUP lessons.</li>
<li>Rent kiteboarding equipment and SUP boards.</li>
<li>Buy kites, kiteboards, accessories, and beachwear at cheap prices.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Hua Hin Thailand has so much to offer besides kitesurfing – wakeboard, ride horses, go golfing and even more!</strong></h2>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 24pt;"><strong>Hua Hin Kitesurfing</strong><strong> Packages:</strong></span></p>
<p><img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-366" src="https://www.sidhusoftwares.net/kba/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin.jpg" alt="" width="847" height="346" srcset="https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin.jpg 735w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin-600x245.jpg 600w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin-300x122.jpg 300w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin-368x150.jpg 368w" sizes="(max-width: 847px) 100vw, 847px" /></p>
